source_file: SIMULATION Pairwise fitting approach binary responses.sas
notes: Sandwich (robust) variance combination in PROC IML from the pairwise fitting approach: block-diagonal Hessian J via block(), gradient cross-product K, pseudo-likelihood covariance Sigma=inv(J)*K*inv(J), and per-parameter SEs from sqrt(vecdiag(.)). The per-pair Hessian/gradient blocks (normally ODS output of the three pairwise NLMIXED fits) are supplied as small numeric matrices of the same shape; the block()/t()/inv()/vecdiag() operations are their exact statements. Consolidated into one PROC IML step to run stand-alone.
